desc: Co-op: the partner player 2 walks plays the walk or the run its own speed calls for, and the animation plays on (no restarts, no held frames). Player 2 runs Goombella at full tilt both ways while player 1 walks Mario slowly (before, the pose came from player 1's stick: the slow walk at run speed, sliding), then walks her diagonally at an in-between speed while Mario stands (before: the run on the spot). Rogueport's plaza, Mario put at 240 0 20
